senses.definition: Something extending across the RGB color space; (especially) something having a wide variety of vivid colors.
RGB lighting; lights (especially LEDs) able to display a wide range of colors by being able to individually adjust the strength of the red, green, and blue channels.
Any of a group of rGyalrongic languages in the Sino-Tibetan language family, spoken in western Sichuan, China.
Of or relating to the rGyalrong languages
